assets.description: Source Blender 5.2.2 scene containing 4-sided protector pyramid with apex crystal sensor, materials, wireframe bevels, lighting, and camera.
Uncompressed standard binary glTF/GLB export (compatible with headless bpy, Three.js, and web runtimes; Draco/MeshOpt disabled for clean zero-dependency parsing).
Rendered 800x600 preview snapshot generated via Blender Cycles/Eevee camera.
Deterministic headless generation script compatible with Blender 5.2.2 LTS (blender -b -P generate_blender_assets.py).
